data.long_meaning: The name Shannu is derived from the name of the Goddess Shiva, who is revered in Hinduism as the destroyer of evil and the source of all creation. This name is believed to bring grace, beauty, and the power of the sun to those who bear it. The name Shannu carries the meaning “Goddess Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Shannu usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shannu is a name that embodies the divine feminine energy and the power of creation and destruction. It is a name that inspires reverence and respect, and is often associated with the Goddess Shiva, who is worshipped as the embodiment of purity, grace, and strength.
data.etymology: Shannu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shannu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
